svg.title: Joint forward/backward plan
svg.desc: Forward: x = [2, 3] is squared and summed to loss = 13. Backward: a compiler-generated vector-Jacobian product returns the gradient 2x = [4, 6]. One plan.run() yields both.
svg.text: One plan run: forward value and backward gradient
∂loss/∂x[i] = 2·x[i] = [4, 6]; joint_plan bundles both directions, one run() returns (value, gradient)
